single.rationale: Beazer Homes shows severe margin deterioration with operating margin collapsing from 11.8% (FY2022) to 1.5% (FY2025) and gross margin falling from 23.3% to 14.2% over the same period. Despite flat revenue, the company's profitability has effectively disappeared, with minimal free cash flow generation ($3.5M on $2.4B revenue) and returns well below cost of capital (3.7% ROE). The homebuilding industry faces significant headwinds from elevated mortgage rates, affordability constraints, and substantial litigation/warranty risks that are expensive to insure against.

team.thesis: Beazer Homes is a homebuilder operating across 13 states, emphasizing energy-efficient construction with an average HERS index score of 32, but the business faces existential margin pressure with operating margin collapsing to 1.5% and net margin to 1.9% in FY2025, leaving virtually no buffer against further pricing pressure, cost inflation, or execution missteps in a challenging macro environment
